comparison.objective: Safely isolate and depressurize a pneumatic manifold, disconnect its push-to-connect tube, and blank the open port with a retained stem plug.
comparison.physical_skill: Valve and padlock manipulation, dump-button operation, collet depression with coordinated tube withdrawal, close-tolerance plug insertion, and retention verification.
comparison.success_condition: Latest full credit requires padlock-before-release and pressure at or below 0.1 bar, tube removal, a released plug seated within 2 mm laterally/3 mm axially and 10° tilt, clearance from arms/tool, a fresh 0.5 s stability window, and survival of a 15 N upward pull for 0.5 s with at most 1 mm displacement; unsafe release is a sticky zero and final success is held 1 s.
comparison.reason: There is meaningful primitive similarity—actuator depression, axial removal/insertion, and pull-retention testing—but this record tests pneumatic isolation, flexible-tube collet release, and port blanking. The candidate additionally requires a movable shackle to carry a suspended workpiece, align it onto three supports, transfer load, verify support, and only then unlock and recover the lifting pin. That load-transfer ability is not tested here.
